name: Shawn J. Olmstead
background: Cowboy State Daily’s Aug. 17, 2022 primary-results story described him as a Riverton man originally from Colorado who billed himself as an ultra-conservative Republican challenger to Sen. Cale Case. The paper said he did not return a Tuesday-night request for comment. A Riverton Ranger announcement URL exists but the live page returned HTTP 429 and nearby Wayback captures were 404.
